title: How do you make a 360° animation of a transparent object?
h1: How to highlight a transparent object with a 360 animation, a video or a photo 💎
metaTitle: How to create visuals for transparent objects
description: Discover through our guide, how Orbitvu photo studios help you enhance your transparent products such as perfume bottles, glasses or bottles, whether in photos, videos or even by creating a 360° animation.
tool: Orbitvu Station software, a perfume bottle and cotton gloves
introText:
Photographing transparent objects, such as wine bottles, dishes, or perfume bottles, can be a real technical challenge. Reflections, light, and contours require careful adjustments to achieve exceptional visuals that are ready to capture the attention of online customers. 📊

With the ALPHASHOT PRO G2, the first AI-assisted photo studio, this complex task can be simplified while still producing professional results.

In this guide, we will explore, step by step, how to make a 360° animation of transparent objects using the AI Assistant through the Orbitvu Station automation software. If you want to make a video or a simple photo, use the same light settings, IQ Mask... 🍷

‍

steps.title: Position your product in the center
steps.content:
First of all, pay attention to the cleanliness of your object, wipe with a rag to remove any fingerprints or dust.

Now, position your object in the center of the studio turntable using the laser or the center point. For this tutorial we will be using a perfume bottle. 📍

We recommend using cotton gloves when placing your product.🧤

✨Tip: Use an invisible Orbitvu stand to elevate your object and get the perfect viewing angle.
steps.structuredText: First of all, pay attention to the cleanliness of your object, wipe with a rag to remove any fingerprints or dust. The first step is to position your object precisely, for this tutorial we will use a perfume bottle. We recommend using cotton gloves to place your product in the center of the photo studio using the built-in lasers and the center point of the turntable.

steps.title: Adjusting the light environment
steps.content:
Click on the AI icon to activate the AI assistant. Artificial intelligence will analyze your product and offer various optimized lighting settings. This step simplifies the preparations.

The assistant will then suggest 4 settings templates different. From the “Models” tab located on the left side of the interface, choose from the 4 light environments offered. 💡

These options can vary from soft lighting to a sharper, more contrasting ambiance. You can always change and adjust the settings according to your preferences to add your own personal touch.

✨ Advice : try a soft atmosphere that subtly highlights curves and reflections.
steps.structuredText: Then access the AI Assistant tool by clicking on the AI icon. Artificial intelligence will automatically analyze your product and suggest different lighting settings. This step not only simplifies preparations, but also lays the groundwork for high-precision photo capture. The assistant will then offer you 4 different settings templates. From the Templates tab on the left side of the interface, choose from the 4 light environments offered. These options can vary, from soft lighting to a sharper, more contrasting ambience.You can always change and adjust the settings to suit your preferences to add your own personal touch. Expert tip: If you're shooting objects like glass bottles, try a soft ambiance that subtly highlights curves and reflections.

steps.title: Adjusting the camera and IQ Mask
steps.content:
Adjust ISO sensitivity, aperture, and shutter speed. Save your changes as reusable templates for simplify your future photo shoots. 📂

Activate IQ Mask, which will allow you to obtain an animation automatically cropped of your object. Using the light adjustment sliders, adjust the opacity of the transparent mask, your object must be more or less black, knowing that the white part of the photo will be removed to make room for transparency.

🚨 Attention : if you want to make a video of your object, be sure to put an SD card in your camera. Also discover How to get an image with a white background without cropping, this technique is essential for a video because the IQ Mask cannot be activated for this type of content.
steps.structuredText: Camera settings: Adjust things like ISO, aperture, and shutter speed.Save your changes as reusable templates to simplify future photo shoots. At this stage, not only are you integrating effective automation, but you're also optimizing the quality and consistency of your images. Now let's move on to the IQ Mask, which will allow you to get an automatic cropped animation of your object. Using the light adjustment sliders, adjust the opacity of the transparent mask, knowing that the white part of the photo will be removed to make way for transparency. Once the mask is perfectly adjusted, save the mask profile so you can apply it to other products of the same typology. Don't worry, changes in light intensity will only be taken into account on the IQ Mask option.

steps.title: Set up the 360° animation
steps.content:
Click on the “360°” button, then choose the number of images per rotation between 24 and 360. To ensure good fluidity in record time, we recommend 24 frames per animation. You can also choose the direction of rotation of the platter. 🔄

If you want to make a video, click on “video” and on the “Custom Length” and “Constant” buttons to get A loop, that is to say an infinite video. You will be able to create a GIF from this video and extract photos from it. ♾️

✨ Advice : Perform a test photo before starting the full animation (or video) to verify that the IQ Mask is set correctly.
steps.structuredText: The 360 format is ideal for online storefronts that want to offer an interactive experience. Click the 360 button, then choose the number of frames per rotation between 24 and 360. To ensure smooth flow in record time, we recommend 24 frames per animation. Perform a test photo before starting the full animation. This makes it possible to identify and correct any problems before the final rendering.

steps.title: Move on to the touch-ups
steps.content:
Retouching is an essential step to enhance the final visual. With the Orbitvu Station software you can:

Adjust contrast, brightness, and colors to highlight the specific characteristics of your product. Optimize the IQ Mask area of the object to perfectly detach it from the background and even add a shadow. 🎨

Once the editing is complete, the settings can be saved as a new profile for quick application to other similar products. 📂
steps.structuredText: Retouching is an essential step to enhance the final visual. With the Orbitvu Station software, you can: Adjust contrast, brightness, and colors to highlight the specific characteristics of your product.Optimize the IQ Mask area (automatic clipping tool) of the object in order to detach it perfectly from the background. Once retouching is complete, the settings can be saved as a new profile for quick application to other similar products.

steps.title: Export and publish your visuals
steps.content:
Once satisfied with the final result, it is time to export your masterpiece. Choose the formats you need, MOV, MP4, or HTML to integrate the code directly on your website. 💻

You can also extract each image separately if needed, in the format of your choice (JPEG, PNG, etc.).

You can also publish your visuals directly from the Orbitvu Station software on your online channels (social networks, e-commerce platform...) thanks to optimized e-commerce integrations.

faqs.question: How long does it take to create a 360° animation of a transparent object?
faqs.answer: Thanks to the complete automation of the process (positioning, lighting, capture, clipping), a 360° animation can be achieved in less than 5 minutes, considerably reducing production time compared to manual shooting.

faqs.question: Is 360° animation compatible with marketplaces like Amazon and Shopify?
faqs.answer: Yes, Orbitvu Station offers optimized e-commerce integrations that allow visuals to be published directly on platforms like Shopify or via plug-ins compatible with marketplaces.

faqs.question: How do you ensure visual consistency across a large collection of products?
faqs.answer: Using the saved shooting models (default or customized), each product is photographed under the same conditions, guaranteeing perfect homogeneity and increased productivity.

faqs.question: Does automating the process reduce production costs?
faqs.answer: Yes, by automating positioning, lighting, clipping, and capture, the Alphashot Pro G2 replaces multiple manual steps, reducing the need for retouching and personnel, which in turn maximizes return on investment.

faqs.question: How many products can you catch per day with this equipment?
faqs.answer: With workflow automation and registered models, the Alphashot Pro G2 can process up to 250 products per day, ensuring fast and consistent mass production.
